# Quality Regression Samples

This folder stores real-world regression case metadata for post-launch image quality work.

Current baseline cases:
- kettle_control_panel_misplaced
- kettle_base_and_lid_drift
- dehumidifier_transparent_tank_error
- dehumidifier_control_panel_wrong_side
- air_purifier_pet_selling_point_missing
- scene_grounding_unrealistic

The fixture set is metadata-only for now so tests can reference stable case IDs without committing customer images.
